title: Monthly Order Counts and Revenue Report
description: CSV export of monthly order counts and total revenue from the orders table, covering January 2024 through September 2026.
user_request: Export a CSV containing monthly order counts and revenue.
sql_query:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE order_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
description: Analysis of top-performing products ranked by total revenue generated from completed and delivered orders, including product details, brand, category, revenue figures, and order counts.
user_request: Generate a PDF with the top 10 products by revenue, including the SQL queries used in a final appendix.
sql_query:
WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.brand,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS order_count
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id IN (
        SELECT order_id 
        FROM orders 
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'delivered')
    )
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category
    ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
)
SELECT * FROM product_revenue LIMIT 10;

title: Monthly Revenue by Product Category Analysis
description: Comprehensive analysis of monthly revenue trends across different product categories. This report includes a multi-series line chart visualization showing revenue performance for each category over time, along with a summary table providing aggregated metrics and key insights for business decision-making.
user_request: Generate a PDF comparing monthly revenue across different product categories using a multi-series line chart and a summary table.
sql_query:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.line_total) AS monthly_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY month, p.category
ORDER BY month, p.category

title: E-Commerce Order Analytics Report
description: Comprehensive analysis of order data including historical trends, status distribution, and channel performance metrics.
user_request: Produce me a PDF report containing a historical chart of orders, a pie chart of order distribution, and some tables regarding order data.
sql_query:
SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage
FROM orders
GROUP BY channel ORDER BY count DESC

title: Top 10 Products by Revenue
description: Analysis of the top 10 products ranked by total revenue from completed orders, including product name, brand, category, order count, and total revenue.
user_request: Show me the top 10 products by revenue.

    p.product_name,
    p.brand,
    p.category,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as total_revenue
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    oi.order_id IN (
        SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.product_name, p.brand, p.category

title: Monthly Revenue by Product Category Analysis
description: Comprehensive analysis of monthly revenue across all product categories, showing trends from January 2024 through May 2024 with a summary table of total revenues per category.
user_request: Generate a PDF comparing monthly revenue across different product categories using a multi-series line chart and a summary table.
sql_query:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
        p.category,
        SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY month, p.category
)
SELECT 
    month,
    category,
    revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month, category

title: Order Analytics Report: Historical Trends & Distribution
description: Comprehensive report containing historical monthly order trends with revenue metrics, order status distribution analysis, and top customer spending data.
user_request: Produce me a report output PDF, containing an historical chart of orders, a pie of order distribution and some tables regarding order data.
sql_query:
-- Historical orders chart: Monthly order counts and totals
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

-- Order distribution pie: Count by order status with percentage
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 
  status,
  order_count,
  ROUND(order_count * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM status_counts), 2) AS percentage
FROM status_counts
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

-- Top customers by total order amount
SELECT 
  c.customer_id,
  c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer_name,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count,
  SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: Monthly Captured Revenue by Payment Method
description: CSV export of monthly captured revenue by payment method
user_request: Export monthly captured revenue by payment method as CSV
sql_query:
SELECT
            STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
            p.method AS payment_method,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_count,
            ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS captured_revenue
        FROM orders o
        JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE p.status = 'captured'
        GROUP BY month, payment_method
        ORDER BY month DESC, captured_revenue DESC
        LIMIT 60
